cod_assessment.rationale: FIS approval pending (requested Nov 2024, not yet approved as of Jun 2026 — 19+ months elapsed without approval). No IA signed. BESS build is 12-18 months once construction starts, but IA + land + permits must come first. Minimum path: FIS approval (6-12 months?) + IA execution (3-6 months) + procurement/construction (12-18 months) = 21-36 months from today → earliest realistic COD late-2028, more likely 2029. COD drift: only 4-day shift so far (2027-12-08 → 2027-12-12) but project has never cleared a single post-screening gate.
cod_assessment.cod_drift_history: 1 change: 2027-12-08 (Nov-Dec 2024) → 2027-12-12 (Jan 2025 → Jun 2026). Unusually stable but project is early-stage with no gates to force drift yet.
cod_assessment.real_or_paper: real_early — developer (OCI Energy) is a credible active BESS developer with financed projects under construction; LLC incorporated 2024 with proper TX foreign registration; substation POI real infrastructure. But no IA, no site activity, FIS pending 19+ months.
